title: Pakistan reaffirms desire for long-term partnership with AIIB
detail: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met the AIIB president and discussed long-term cooperation, development priorities, and future investment links.

title: How to Secure Your WhatsApp Account Before You Lose Access
detail: PTA advised users to keep the SIM linked to WhatsApp active and registered so the account does not become inaccessible.

title: Karachi judiciary security affected as police fuel supply suspended
detail: Karachi's judicial security unit faced pressure after PSO suspended fuel supply because of unpaid dues, raising security concerns.

title: Pakistan mulls over sovereign asset tokenization and the role blockchain infrastructure
detail: Finance officials discussed blockchain-based sovereign debt and digital investment products as part of Pakistan's financial modernization plans.

title: Federal Shariat Court restores Section 325 criminalising suicide attempt
detail: The Federal Shariat Court restored PPC Section 325 and struck down the 2022 amendment that had decriminalised attempted suicide.

title: Saad Edhi among activists detained during Gaza aid mission
detail: Saad Edhi was detained during a Gaza aid flotilla as the humanitarian mission was intercepted and several activists were taken into custody.

title: US stopped 'Project Freedom' at Pakistan's request, says Marco Rubio
detail: Marco Rubio said the US paused Project Freedom after Pakistan asked for space for diplomacy with Iran.

title: Trump says delaying Iran attack at request of Gulf leaders
detail: Donald Trump said he would hold off on an Iran attack while negotiations continued and Gulf leaders pushed for a deal.

title: Anmol Pinky: Karachi court orders remand proceedings to be held in jail
detail: A Karachi court ordered that remand proceedings for Anmol alias Pinky be held inside jail because of security concerns.

title: 'Stranger Things' star Noah Schnapp celebrates graduation with family
detail: Noah Schnapp celebrated graduating from the University of Pennsylvania and shared family moments from the ceremony.

title: Uber adds to stake in Germany's Delivery Hero, becomes biggest shareholder
detail: Uber expanded its holding in Delivery Hero to become the largest shareholder, according to company disclosure and Reuters reporting.

title: As chip industry chases AI, US national labs look to newcomers for supercomputers
detail: US national labs are looking beyond Nvidia and AMD for chip suppliers as AI demand changes the supercomputing market.
